decisions.reason: The particle therapy water phantom serves a specialized but strategic niche and is worth keeping to maintain a complete portfolio.
This small volume ionization chamber fills a specific clinical measurement need and has no immediate replacement, so it should be retained.
As another small volume chamber with distinct specifications, it complements the dosimetry range and should remain on the market.
The standard clinical ionization chamber line is central to the firm's core offering and has extremely low risk of being discontinued.
This chamber for relative dosimetry supports essential QA workflows and continues to be relevant for clinical users.
The thimble ionization chamber is a proven conventional design that remains in steady demand and should be kept.
